prerequisites: knowledge of matter cover according to the physics education program in the range of Physics module
Ability of individual performance of laboratory experiments, enhanced by elementary manual dexterity
Awareness of the team working necessity and ability of its execution

learning_outcomes.text: Names and describes the laws of thermodynamics and thermodynamic processes
Characterises and explains air standard cycles and is able to evaluate its efficiency
Names and describes the procedures of the air standard cycles realization in combustion engines and piston compressors
Is able to calculate the level of imperfection of the adiabatic, isothermal process as an example of polytropic process
Calculates values of specific heat for gasses and volumetric efficiency of a piston compressor
Calculates and verifies coefficient of heat transfer through a plat plate as well as conductive coefficient for forced and natural convection
Understand the necessity and is aware of possibilities of continuous education, particularly increasing their knowledge of technical thermodynamics (studies II and III degree)

Is aware of the importance, responsibility and the effects of engineer work from Mechanical Engineering faculty in terms of responsibility for the environment, resulting from the proper use of the knowledge of technical thermodynamics
Recognizes the need to improve professional skills, personal and social

syllabus_topics: Basic definitions: mass, the amount of pressure, temperature, volume
I Law of Thermodynamics - work, heat, internal energy, power, thermodynamic system open – closed
I Law of Thermodynamics for open thermodynamic systems - enthalpy, volume and technical work
Thermodynamic processes calculation of heat and work variations
Cycles, entropy, the efficiency of cycles
Carnot Cycle, Second Law of Thermodynamics, reversible processes, irreversible entropy relationship of the Second Law of Thermodynamic
The flow of gas through the nozzles, the energy balance for open movable systems, dynamic stream performance
Basic air standard cycles for engine, efficiencies and comparison
Combustion, the calorific value of the fuel, combustion control charts
Internal and external combustion piston and gas turbine engines
Stirling engine air standard cycle and its practical realisation
Piston and rotodynamic; energy balance, an indicator diagram and operation of the compressor
Basic laws of heat transfer by convection, radiation and conduction
Compressible fluid flow
Diaphragm, convective heat exchangers
Determination of the specific heat of the gas
Practical realization of adiabatic process
Examination of the adiabatic flow through a Bendemann nozzle
Determination of volumetric efficiency of a piston compressor
The study of isothermal process
Determination of heat transfer coefficients for forced and natural convection
Examination of the process of heat transfer through a flat barrier with: a) the occurrence of convection and radiation, b) applying a debilitating radiation screen
Isobaric heating using heat regeneration
teaching_methods: self study - preparation for laboratory class

assessment_methods.method: quiz and report from Lab F1
quiz and report from Lab F2
quiz and report from Lab F3

assessment_rules: For the lecture component, the final grade (P) is calculated as the average of F1, F2, and F3 (P = 0.33F1 + 0.33F2 + 0.33F3). For the laboratory component, the final grade (P) is calculated similarly as the average of F1, F2, and F3, which include quizzes and reports from the laboratory. All components must be passed with a grade.
degree: Mechanical Engineering and Machine Building (I level, full-time)
